verdict.rationale: Baseten documents function/tool calling and structured outputs (JSON schema conformance) as first-party inference features, and supports OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible SDKs that typically carry tool-calling semantics, but the docs never explicitly address parallel tool calls, multi-step agent loops, or reliability guarantees specific to open models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parallel/multi-step tool-calling support, any benchmark or independent evidence of faithful tool-call behavior on open models, and confirmation the feature works uniformly across the open-model catalog rather than just being described generically.
